articles.title: Macron in Syria on first post-Assad visit by West European head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived in Damascus on July 6, 2026, marking the first visit by a Western European head of state since Syria's new authorities took power, to reaffirm France's commitment to Syrian sovereignty and reconstruction.

articles.title: REPLAY: Macron addresses Ukraine, Greenland at NATO summit
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron told reporters at the NATO summit that he does not believe the US would seize Greenland, while also addressing the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

articles.title: Why are Macron's aviator glasses in the spotlight again?
articles.summary: The French president has been spotted wearing sunglasses indoors again, prompting discussion about his eyewear and what it reveals about France's optical industry.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron hosted a G7 summit at the Palace of Versailles where he courted US President Donald Trump, though analysts noted his diplomatic gestures have often failed to translate into lasting strategic influence.

articles.title: 'For sure': Macron to preach stronger Europe vision at G7 swansong
articles.summary: Emmanuel Macron hosted his last G7 summit as French president, promoting his vision of European strategic autonomy and independence from the United States, though critics note Europe has made limited progress in implementing his ideas.
